result:
The webhooks page now shows a Created column and a Duplicate button on each row. The copy appears in the list straight after it is created. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked. I also did not commit anything.

**What changed** (all under `apps/web`):
- **Created column:** each row shows the creation date, formatted with the shared `formatDateForDisplay` helper. The Updated column stays. To fit both, the data columns were rebalanced to 12 grid units, and the heading matches.
- **Duplicate button:** it creates a new webhook with the same URL, triggers and surveys, and the name `Copy of <name>`. The server generates a new signing secret for it. It is hidden for read-only users. It shows a loading state while it runs and a toast on success or failure.
- **List refresh:** after a successful duplicate the page calls `router.refresh()`. The list is ordered by newest first, so the copy shows at the top.
- **Row structure:** the old version wrapped each whole row in a `<button>`, so a Duplicate button can't sit inside it. The row now has a clickable button over the data cells, and the Duplicate button sits beside it. `WebhookTable` renders the rows itself, because a server-rendered row can't receive a click handler.
- **i18n:** I added one en-US string, `workspace.integrations.webhooks.webhook_duplicated_successfully`. The rest reuses existing keys (`common.created`, `common.duplicate`).

**Decisions you may want to change:**
- **Reusing the existing create action:** AGENTS.md says not to add new server actions and to put new backend work in `/api/v3`. I did not add either. The Duplicate button calls the existing `createWebhookAction`. Moving it to a v3 route would mean spec and generation work, which I think is out of scope for a UI request. Tell me if you want that.
- **Unnamed webhooks:** the copy name falls back to the URL, so an unnamed webhook becomes `Copy of https://...`. Without this, the copy would look identical to the original in the list.
- **Source:** the copy's source is always `user`, so it can be edited in the UI, like a webhook added by hand.
- **No endpoint test:** the copy is not pinged, because the URL was already validated when the original was created. The create path still validates the URL.
- **Name not translated:** `Copy of` is a fixed English string, because it is stored data and you specified the exact text.
- **Icon-only button:** the Duplicate button is an icon with an accessible label and tooltip, to fit the narrow action column.

**Not done or not verified:**
- **`pnpm i18n` was not run.** The sandbox denied the command. It needs to run so the other locale files get the new string. I did not edit those files by hand.
- **Next.js docs were not checked.** Neither `.next-docs/` nor the copy inside `node_modules/next` is present in this checkout. I did not run the refresh command, because it downloads a package and rewrites a checked-in skill file. The row follows the same `router.refresh()` and serialized-props pattern the add and settings modals already use.
- **Lint and type checks were not run.** I fixed the import order in the row file by hand.
